HOME SCIENCE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: HOME SCIENCE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Petrol fires have no fuel
   B. Water removes heat too quickly
   C. Water always increases oxygen
   D. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

2. The SI unit of force is the: (1 mark)
   A. joule (J)
   B. newton (N)
   C. pascal (Pa)
   D. watt (W)

3. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 100 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 37 °C

4. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Glucose and oxygen
   B. Only carbon dioxide
   C. Nitrogen gas only
   D. Only water vapour

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Planning Family Meals? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Planning Family Meals.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Planning Family Meals.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Planning Family Meals.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Planning Family Meals.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Laundering of Fabrics? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundering of Fabrics.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Laundering of Fabrics.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Laundering of Fabrics.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Laundering of Fabrics.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Food Preservation? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Preservation.
   B. Guess results without recording observations on Food Preservation.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Food Preservation.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Food Preservation.

8. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   C. A mixture of two liquids
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

9. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.

10. Diffusion is best described as: (1 mark)
   A. Heating until a solid melts
   B. Net movement of particles from high to low concentration
   C. Movement of water only across a membrane
   D. A chemical reaction forming ash

11. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Burning crop residue every week
   B. Overgrazing continuously
   C. Removing all vegetation
   D. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Personal Appearance and Etiquette? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Appearance and Etiquette.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Planning Family Meals and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Meal Service and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Food Preservation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Cake Making and Decoration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. D — Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely

2. B — newton (N)

3. B — 100 °C

4. A — Glucose and oxygen

5. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Planning Family Meals.

6. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Laundering of Fabrics.

7. A — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Food Preservation.

8. B — A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means

9. B — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Control of Household Pests and Insects 2.4 Laundering of Fabrics 2.5 Interior De.

10. B — Net movement of particles from high to low concentration

11. D — Planting cover crops and terracing slopes

12. D — Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Personal Appearance and Etiquette.
